cues: A salt forms when an acid reacts with a base.
By composition there are six kinds.
Normal salts, with every replaceable hydrogen replaced.
Acid salts, like sodium bicarbonate, with some still left.
Basic salts, with some hydroxide left.
Double salts like Mohr's salt and potash alum.
And complex salts like potassium ferrocyanide.
text: A salt forms when an acid reacts with a base. By composition there are six kinds. Normal salts, with every replaceable hydrogen replaced. Acid salts, like sodium bicarbonate, with some still left. Basic salts, with some hydroxide left. Double salts like Mohr's salt and potash alum. Mixed salts like bleaching powder. And complex salts like potassium ferrocyanide.
